avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces grazoprevir plasma concentrations by up to 50%, compromising antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently or within 2 weeks of discontinuation

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases grazoprevir exposure below therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication; use alternative antimicrobial agents

avoid_supplements.name: Eleutherococcus (Siberian Ginseng)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce grazoprevir bioavailability and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consider alternative adaptogens if needed

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit extract/seed
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally increase grazoprevir levels; clinical relevance uncertain
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; limit grapefruit consumption

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 modulation and OATP inhibition; minimal clinical data
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; report concurrent use to healthcare provider

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and OATP inhibition increases grazoprevir plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity/QT prolongation
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products during treatment course

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase grazoprevir absorption; take with food for optimal bioavailability as recommended
caution_foods.action: Consistent food intake pattern advised; take with meal as per prescribing guidelines

monitoring_notes: Grazoprevir is highly dependent on CYP3A4 metabolism and OATP transporters; monitor for treatment efficacy (HCV viral load) and hepatic function, especially in combination with elbasvir. Educate patients on strict avoidance of CYP3A4 inducers and grapefruit to maintain therapeutic drug levels.
